Description.SourceString:
Hate is more than just an emotion: it’s a chain. It holds onto us, grasping our thoughts, reshaping our memories and driving our actions. Hate lasts longer than it should, and sometimes that hate lingers long after the hater has passed.

These revenants are echoes of those who foolishly attempted to battle Kuldra. In their dying moments, they were grasped by their hatred for the dragon queen and that hatred latched onto them and stitched them to the world.

Now, they cannot tell the difference between friend or foe, and are driven only by a hateful need to destroy every living thing in their path.
